name: the-race
description: the RACE: a text roguelike you play in your own words. A deterministic engine owns the dice and the truth; the agent tells the story.

game_folder.title: Game folder
game_folder.description: Where the RACE keeps its files: the saves (closed to the narrator) and the evidence board you open in a browser. Choose a plain folder you can open, without a profile name or a cloud drive in the path. The default is a Windows path; on macOS and Linux keep it to use the-race in your home directory, or enter your own.
